collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A bright parrot perched near the huts repeats a word it must have heard nearby.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: A bright parrot perched near the huts repeats a word it must have heard nearby. Everyone tries to work out who taught it the word.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: A bright parrot perched near the huts repeats a word it must have heard nearby. The word is (subject)'s name, said in a voice very much like (friend)'s.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: A bright parrot perched near the huts repeats a word it must have heard nearby. It repeats the word all afternoon, to the children's delight.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: A bright parrot perched near the huts repeats a word it must have heard nearby. A cook realizes it is the word they shout when the stew is ready.
